gold.why: The divisibility computation is a top-level lemma `calculation` (33-41), and `problem imo1959_p1` (50-51) just applies `calculation n k h1 h2`.
`constructor` (33) splits `n ∈ solution_set ↔ 2^n ≡ 1 [MOD 7]` into both directions; the reverse direction is closed by `mod_cases H : n % 3` (44).
`imo_1964_p1b'` is structural recursion on `n`: base cases `| 0 | 1 | 2 => by decide` and step `| n + 3 =>` using the recursive call (78-79).
`lemma2` introduces x,y,z by `refine ⟨a, 1, (1/b), ...⟩` (63) and then proves positivity and the three product identities.
Schur's inequality is proved for all nonnegative a,b,c; two `wlog` reductions (32, 35) reduce the general case to the ordered one, a convenient stronger statement proved once.

Inside `namespace Condition` the API for the structure is stated next to it (`a_pos`, `g_spec`, `N_spec`, `gcd_eq_g`, `dvd_g_of_le_N_of_dvd`), so later proofs rewrite with these instead of unfolding `Condition`.
`bound` is proved once for arbitrary positive a,b,c (36-40) and then instantiated at the three cyclic permutations (47-49).

`obtain hdvd | ⟨p, hpprime, hdvd, hpodd⟩ := Nat.four_dvd_or_exists_odd_prime_and_dvd_of_two_lt h` splits the exponent into a multiple of 4 or of an odd prime, each discharged by a known theorem (280-281).
`exists_minimal` uses `Nat.find` (71) to produce a minimal counterexample triple and then extracts its properties from the nonempty set of counterexamples.
The problem statements are fixed in `problem.lean` as `:= by sorry` theorems (51-69), while `solution.lean` proves them separately, so each statement is an immutable object.
`gExp_move` proves the p-adic exponent `gExp p` is unchanged by any single `Move`; this is the invariant used later in the reachability induction.
`induction h with | refl => rfl | tail _ hstep ih => rw [ih, gExp_move hp hstep]` proves the invariant along `Reachable`.
`rcases le_total a b with h | h` splits the gcd identity into the two possible orders, each closed by rewriting `min` and `max`.
`bad_points_card_le_two` extracts three distinct points p₁,p₂,p₃ from `3 ≤ bad.ncard` and hands them to `circle_at_most_two_opposite_color` via `refine ⟨p₁, p₂, p₃, ...⟩` (196).
`induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on` (108) gives `ih : ∀ m < n`; the step is then split by `by_cases hn1` (111) and `by_cases hcop` (114).

Every `have` in the inductive step is discharged by a separately declared lemma (`..._h_main_1`, `..._h_card_erase_1`, `..._h_sum_card_1`, `..._h_translation_equivalence_1`), so the extracted lemma carries the whole local context.
A family of near-identical lemmas `..._h_sum_card_h1` to `_h4`, one per micro-step (nonempty, erase card, arithmetic, combination), each with the same binder block and chained by `..._h_sum_card`.
`pfr_aux` is a blueprint node with `\lean{PFR_conjecture_aux}` (15) and a `\uses{...}` list of eight dependencies (25), and the main `pfr` theorem cites it at 56.
`theorem:CE_Main` is a node whose `\uses{...}` lists six earlier nodes (`E8-Lattice`, `SpherePackingConstant`, `SpherePacking.density`, `E8Packing-density`, `thm:g`, `thm:Cohn-Elkies-general`).
Corollary `FermatLastTheorem.of_p_ge_5` carries `\lean{...}` and `\uses{fermatLastTheoremThree, FermatLastTheorem.of_odd_primes}`, a node in the reduction dependency graph.
`metric_carleson` is a four-step `calc` (212-242): biSup reformulation, enumeration, argmax simple function, and finally `linearized_metric_carleson`.
`discrete_carleson` proves `∃ G'` by `use G'` from `exceptional_set` (49-51), then splits the integral over `G \ G'` into `forest_union` and `forest_complement`.
One theorem per file: this file only states `fermat_last_theorem` and applies `P2MW.S_fermat_last_theorem.solution`, so the import graph is the citation graph.
`main_theorem` is stated and closed by `sorry` in a `StatementOnly_` file, kept separate from the solution file that proves it.
`Everywhere_idem` is an equality of predicates, proved by `ext x` (27) and then both directions (`constructor <;> intro h`).
`everywhere_of_subterm_of_everywhere` inducts on the free magma (54) and, in the fork case, splits `SubtermOf` with `obtain (rfl | hsub | hsub)` (59).
The skill prescribes 'Generalize First, Instantiate Last': prove `suffices ∀ s, statement_about s` for an arbitrary parameter, then `convert` back to the specific instance.
The extraction ladder moves a repeated sub-argument from a local `have` (step 1, 168-184) to a standalone lemma once its statement is independently interesting (steps 2-3).
Todo-based workflow for many sorries: enumerate every `sorry` (54-57), fill one at a time without moving on (59-62), and gate each with `lake env lean` (64-68).
When candidates fail, the escalation is to replace the stuck goal with smaller sub-sorries ('Break into smaller sub-sorries') and to retain a documented TODO strategy.
